description: Update the porosity, particle-applied force, and drag force. This happens automatically during cycling (see cfd interval ). This command is useful for testing.

examples.description: Recompute porosity, applied force and drag force

notes: Requires a nonzero fluid density on every element first; otherwise the command is rejected with 'The fluid density of all elements must be greater than zero' on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): after setting a nonzero element density, cfd update runs and computes the element porosity (0.9916 for the probe mesh) identically on all three consoles.
